title: The star
prompt:
REFERENCE IMAGE ROLES:
— the previous frame of this storyboard. BASE IMAGE: edit it as instructed; everything the instruction does not change stays exactly as it is.
— a gold emblem on black: an open circle broken at the upper right, crossed by a level bar and a steep slanted bar that meet in a small stepped block. OBJECT REFERENCE: this is the Thoughtform brand mark. Reproduce its shape exactly.

Edit the base image. Change ONE thing: the stepped block where the two gaps cross becomes the one lit thing in the picture. It glows warm gold-white with a small soft halo, and a few fine dotted rays run a short way along the two gaps. Nothing else becomes brighter. Keep exactly everything else: the silhouette, the walls, the crescent, the sectors and their contents, the fraying, the palette and the camera. No words or letters.
